evals.prompt: Use document-companion. I want to understand databases/certificates/ before deciding what to organize. Read its collection README; do not open personal records yet.

evals.prompt: Use document-companion. Here is a temporary fixture: projects/Example/report.pdf and writing/report.tex are the final output and its maintained source; projects/Example/notes.md contains planning. Propose how to arrange them. Do not move anything.
evals.expected_output: Preserve source and export relationships, distinguish Notion planning from local deliverables, propose an explicit disposition without deleting notes or writing Notion, and stay within the fixture.

evals.prompt: Use document-companion. Explain how AGENTS.md, Home.md, schema.md and folder READMEs should work together. Inspect the current guidance but do not edit it or open private evidence.
evals.expected_output: Give each file a distinct role, identify current contradictions, preserve scoped CV and privacy rules, distinguish proposal from accepted state, and make no changes.

evals.prompt: A fixture certificates README requires nguyen-xuan-tai_<type>.pdf. Move a degree and two distinct transcripts there, put a general grading guide under institutions, and consolidate a different application CV into writing/cv without overwriting the maintained CV. evals.prompt: In another workspace the root databases/README.md is the agreed entrance. Discuss organizing documents without changing its layout or requiring Notion.
evals.expected_output: Follow that workspace README scope rather than imposing Personal Hub collection-level layout; remain read-only.
